sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:25

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:25:1
items.html: AA returned a second time to couple within himself [Minei uVei], in the discernment of his internality, and he did not clothe within AVI: As above, for now he must receive from the statures of the HGT of Nekudim, which the HGT of Atik took. But since this is the second Ibur, of the Mochin, he must receive these HGT in the discernment of what they return to be HBD, that is, from the clothing of the ZAT of Atik within the Rosh of AA, where they become HBD, as is known. Therefore they have now no matter whatsoever of clothing in AVI of Atzilut.
